Metadata.title: Cyclops
Metadata.description: For students and self-learners: inspect a 3D model and ask an agent that knows which part you selected.

NotFound.title: We couldn't find that route
NotFound.body: Head back to the lab or switch language.

Marketing.heroLead: Inspect a 3D model. Ask about the part you clicked. Six objects, for students.
Marketing.heroBody: For students and self-learners in architecture, mechanics, and computing. Inspect a 3D model, click a part, and ask an agent that already knows which one you selected. Not photorealism, not a credential: six objects to identify parts, without the physical thing.
Marketing.problemTitle: A diagram does not teach space
Marketing.problemBody: Class gives you a 2D drawing. Reality nests parts inside parts. Without a shop, a site, or a lab, identification turns into memorizing names.
Marketing.patternSubtitle: The same gesture in all three domains. The object and the vocabulary change. The way you explore does not.

object.title: Object
object.body: Load a catalog system: an engine, a motherboard, a room.

layers.title: Layers
layers.body: Inspect envelopes until the working structure shows: chassis, services, enclosure.

components.title: Components
components.body: Click a part. Chat answers about that, not about the universe.

Marketing.liveSubtitle: A 3D viewer, an agent tied to the part you clicked, and identification practice. That is the product today. The agent cannot see pixels. It sees the part you selected.

viewer.title: 3D viewer
viewer.body: Orbit, zoom, click. Low-poly on purpose, so you can read the hierarchy instead of a pretty render.

agent.title: Contextual agent
agent.body: It answers about the part you selected. With no click, it asks you to pick one on the model.

practice.title: Identification practice
practice.body: It names a part; you find it on the model, with labels hidden. Misses, hints, and a history.

Marketing.modesTitle: Faults and diagnosis are not a toggle
Marketing.modesNote: There is no mode picker in the app. Today you open a model, inspect layers, and practice finding parts. Fault finding and guided diagnosis use the same viewer and the same agent, with a different teaching goal. They are not in the UI yet.

explore.title: Exploration and practice
explore.body: Identify parts at your own pace. Inspect, select, and ask what a piece does. Or start practice: it names a part, you find it on the model.

faults.title: Fault finding
faults.body: A symptom. You investigate on the model. The agent narrows causes and does not dump the answer up front. Not a mode you can turn on today.

diagnosis.title: Guided diagnosis
diagnosis.body: A case with steps, the way a technician would work. The agent says what to inspect first. Also not something you pick in the app.

computing.title: Computing
computing.blurb: Enclosure → board → CPU, RAM, slots. In the catalog: a motherboard and a server rack.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.blurb: Envelope → structure → services. In the catalog: a living room and a bamboo structural system.

mechanics.title: Mechanics
mechanics.blurb: Block → subsystems → piston, gears. In the catalog: a combustion engine and a gearbox.

Marketing.closeBody: Made for students and self-learners at a low-to-mid technical level. Not a substitute for formal training, and not a job tool for licensed professionals.

Home.title: Home
Home.subtitle: Recent projects by topic, plus newly added projects. Data is mocked.

Canvas.title: Canvas
Canvas.indexBody: Pick a project from home, or open a seeded placeholder.
Canvas.clickMesh: Click a mesh. That selection is what the agent can talk about.
Canvas.signedInNoConvex: Clerk session is up, Convex token is not. Refresh once so the lab backend can pick it up.
Canvas.signInToChat: Sign in to persist selection and talk to the lab instructor.
Canvas.emptyChat: Ask what the selected mesh does. Without a click, I will send you back to the canvas.
Canvas.authHintJwt: Clerk issued a Convex JWT, but the backend never accepted it. This machine likely has a different NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL than the shared silent-lobster-652 deployment.
Canvas.authHintNoToken: Clerk is signed in, but getToken({ template: "convex" }) returned nothing. This Clerk app needs a JWT template named convex, and .env.local must use the same Clerk keys as the shared Cyclops Learn app.
Canvas.authHintTemplate: Clerk is signed in, but the convex JWT template failed. Create a JWT template named convex on this Clerk app, or copy the shared .env.local keys.

Practice.title: Identification practice
Practice.intro: I name a part and you find it by clicking the model. No labels in view: if you miss, I hint; every attempt counts toward your history.
Practice.historyHint: We start with the parts that gave you trouble in earlier rounds.
Practice.hintRevealed: Its label is visible on the model.
Practice.rotateHint: Orbit the model and click where you think it is.
Practice.correctWithLabel: You found it with the label visible. {summary}
Practice.gaveUp: It was here (label on the model). {summary}
